Open Start and type your company name and your own numbers in the yellow cells: the lowest margin you accept, the order value for free shipping, the hours you want to take to reply and the days you aim to ship in.

Orders lists your online shop and marketplace orders. Type the order, the amounts and the dates; the cost of goods, the profit, the margin and the margin check fill in. Order lines holds the products of each order.
Use the Packing queue every morning: it shows what waits to be packed, the due date and the hours waiting, and flags an order that is due today or overdue.

Shipments records every parcel with its method, weight, courier cost and tracking status. The days in transit and a check against the days you promise fill in. Shipping methods holds your price and the courier cost for each weight band.
Returns, Refunds and Cancellations record every parcel that comes back and every order that stops. Courier claims and Order issues keep the open cases with their days open.
Discount codes shows the uses and the discount given by each code. Delivery times compares the days you promise with the real days for each country.
Customer enquiries records the day and time a message came and when you replied, so the hours to reply are checked against your target.
Gift notes and Packaging costs keep the gift orders and the cost of each packaging kit. The Daily order summary adds up every day for the charts.

Use the 14 calculators before you decide: order profit, shipping cost, free shipping, packaging, refund impact, discount code, delivery date, packing time, repeat rate, customer value, return rate, cancellation cost and peak week.
Read the Orders and Shipping Dashboard and the Charts every week: orders, sales, margin, shipping gap, late parcels, returns, refunds, open issues and reply times.

Custom order deliveries with method and delay
One row for each custom order that is ready, on its way or delivered with the method; the client, the days waiting and the days late fill in.
Corporate clients with orders, spend and last order
One row for each business client with the contact and the orders before this workbook; the orders, the spend on the orders listed, the average order and the repeat check fill in.
Gift set options with cost, price and margin
One row for each gift set you offer with the cost of the goods and of the box and ribbon and the price of one set; the cost of the set, the profit and the margin fill in.

One row for each item you take to a stall with the day bought, the cost, the condition and the place it is kept; the age in years fills in.
Leads collected at events with follow-up
One row for each person who asked about gifts, wholesale or custom orders at a stall with the interest and the day you followed up; the days and the follow-up check fill in.
